name: Eliab (David's eldest brother)
title: Jesse's firstborn son
summary: Eliab was the oldest of Jesse's eight sons and David's older brother. He was a tall and impressive man whom the prophet Samuel initially thought was God's chosen one to become king, but God rejected him because He looks at the heart, not the outward appearance. Eliab later served in King Saul's army and showed anger toward David when he came to the battlefield against the Philistines.

keyEvents.title: Rejected as a Candidate for King
keyEvents.description: When Samuel came to anoint a new king among the sons of Jesse, he saw Eliab's impressive appearance and thought he must be the chosen one. But God said that He does not look at what people look at, for people look at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

keyEvents.title: Eliab's Anger Toward David
keyEvents.description: When David came to the army to bring food to his brothers and asked about Goliath, Eliab became angry and accused David of pride and evil in his heart, and of having left the sheep just to watch the battle.

keyEvents.title: Served in Saul's Army
keyEvents.description: Eliab was among the three eldest sons of Jesse who followed Saul into war against the Philistines in the Valley of Elah.

keyEvents.title: Eliab's Daughter Married into David's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Eliab's daughter Abihail married Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, which reunited the family lines.
